title: Tokio Marine Direct says unauthorized access to its customer mypage leaked personal information, Security NEXT reports
date_note: Security NEXT's page, published 27 November, gives no earlier disclosure day; the company detected the access on 4 November.
summary: Security NEXT reports Tokio Marine Direct disclosed that unauthorized access to its customer mypage leaked personal information. The company detected suspicious access on 4 November 2026 and says a service it was connected to was used as the route. As of 9 November it had confirmed the leak of 93 people's information, including related parties, across 71 contracts.
plain: Security NEXT reports insurer Tokio Marine Direct says its customer mypage was accessed without permission and personal information leaked: 93 people's data, including related parties, across 71 contracts as of 9 November.
exec: Security NEXT reports an insurer says a connected service was the route into its customer portal and 93 people's data leaked, as of 9 November.

evidence.quote: 11月9日時点で契約など71件に関し、関係者を含む93人分の個人情報が流出したことを確認している。
2026年11月4日、マイページに対する不審なアクセスを検知。
